question: In which year was the football world cup started?
solution:
The correct answer is **1930**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first FIFA World Cup** was held in 1930.
 
• **Uruguay** was the host country for the inaugural tournament.
 
• **Thirteen teams** participated in the first World Cup.
 
• The tournament was won by **Uruguay**, who defeated Argentina 4-2 in the final.
 
• The FIFA World Cup is held every **four years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Details
 
 
 
 

 Host Country
 **Uruguay** hosted the first FIFA World Cup in 1930.
 
 

 Number of Teams
 A total of **13 teams** participated in the inaugural tournament.
 
 

 Winner
 **Uruguay** won the first World Cup by defeating Argentina.
 
 

 Frequency
 The FIFA World Cup is held every **four years**.
 
 

 Significance
 The FIFA World Cup is one of the **most prestigious** sports tournaments in the world.
